answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Ledger: each agent identity must solve a fresh, server-seeded puzzle whose answer encodes that agent's prior interaction history, then publish it before acting. A violet proof tag lets peers verify the solution once, while reused answers are rejected at the jetty checkpoint before any transaction passes. Creating N usable identities costs N distinct solved histories plus computation and storage per solve. Honest agents gain a haven from replay, but attackers pay linear work and risk flagging for repeated near-duplicate solutions.
